lessons.title: Practice Temperature Conversion
lessons.description: Finish fahrenheitToCelsius. Convert Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius using (fahrenheit - 32) * 5 / 9. The test checks that c is about 100.0.
learning_objectives: Plaza clerks recount crates before dawn, and apply formula 5 9 using doubles.

tests.name: test_conversion
tests.test_code: double c = Solution.fahrenheitToCelsius(212.0); if (Math.abs(c - 100.0) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 100.0");
